name: json_literals
description: Translate Python boolean and missing-value literals into their JSON spelling; controls copy the Python literal from the same record.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
keys=['active','enabled','visible','ready','valid','cached','online','complete','locked','available']
for i in range(96):
 v=[True,False,None][i%3]; key=random.choice(keys); src=repr(v)
 prefix=f'Python record: {{"{key}": {src}}}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+'Write only the JSON literal for the value. Answer:', 'answer':' '+json.dumps(v)})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+'Copy only the Python literal for the value. Answer:', 'answer':' '+src})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
